FILE: donor path -> target path (module root m3/intern). PACKAGE: donor package -> target package. TYPE: donor type -> target type (identity for the relocated types; the donor's dependency type maps onto the owner). EXTERNAL: a non-JDK package imported unchanged (JUnit 5, test scope).

# REWRITE (6 columns): kind, donor path, donor text, target text, occurrences, reason; TSV escapes \n (the file's end of line), \t, \\; applied in map order after DROP / CTOR and before the line mapping (donor text in donor names, target text in target names). PIN: a token that must occur in the target exactly as often as in the donor (the append-only literal-kind ids of the archive and the test data: NaN payloads, unpaired surrogates). OMIT: donor files left out by decision (nothing copied; blob pinned in the run log).
